limitations: static audit; callback order read from ANDES code and confirmed on stored series

claim: The post-event affine predictor (post-jump anchoring, zero initial condition, RDC active, PSS included) reproduces observed P peaks/troughs within 0.006 pu (optimistic side) on DESIGN buses
scope: P outputs, P/Q steps at buses 8,23,28,25, z_ref and one redispatched point
limitations: Q/S/V outputs not modelled; 5 P events; first-sample proxy errors up to 0.075 pu for GFMs
allowed_wording: The predictor was audited against ANDES on DESIGN events with the stated errors.

claim: On the frozen prospective cohort (6 buses, +58.564 MW, 24 TDS) M0 violates P limits in 6/6 scenarios (7 unit-scenario pairs, SG31 in all), M1 0, M2 1 pair (0.0096 pu), M3 0
scope: six buses (3,29,15,12,27,26), one amplitude, 200 s, stored samples at dt=2^-8 s
limitations: 6 clusters, no inferential statistics; stored samples only; the voltage design margin and cost scales were fixed after DESIGN/TUNE pilots, before freezing
allowed_wording: In this cohort M3 had no P violations while M0 and M2 did.
forbidden_wording: M3 is safe/certified; superiority in general; statistical significance

scope: equal-compliance contrast (M1 = smallest compliant rho of the predeclared grid)
limitations: J is a displacement/pattern cost, not an economic cost; equal-cost contrast NOT_MATCHED (J differs by > 10 %)
allowed_wording: At equal observed compliance M3 required less redispatch than the static-reserve method.
forbidden_wording: M3 is cheaper in economic terms

claim: Modelling the algebraic jump (M0 -> M2) reduces observed P violations from 7 to 1 pair; modelling the excursion and multi-contingency (M2 -> M3) from 1 to 0
limitations: single remaining M2 violation is a post-jump excursion; sample of 6
allowed_wording: Both terms contribute in this cohort.
forbidden_wording: the terms are independently necessary in general

scope: frozen dispatches at the 6 test events (post-hoc predictions)
limitations: ablation on the same events used for the comparison; no TDS

allowed_wording: The redispatch methods do not change the frequency transient materially.
